newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-96 CPI at 18.71 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-96 CPI at 18.71 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks eased again in November after a one-off October rise broke an earlier three-month downward trend, a monthly Reuter poll of the 25 biggest banks showed on Thursday.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation for the end of this year at 18.71 percent on average, against 18.74 percent last month and the government's prediction of 17.8 percent.
The forecast is a mean average of predictions ranging between 17.90 and 19.50 percent. @
Year-on-year inflation was 19.5 percent in September. Official data for October will be announced by the Central Statistical Office on November 15.
Banks forecast monthly inflation in November at an average of 1.26 percent, with a range from 0.30 to 1.70 percent.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation 12 months ahead, in November 1997, at an average of 16.54 percent with a range from 14.8 to 18.8 percent.
